critical_holes.title: Choose one B1 entry path
critical_holes.finding: H1 adds the old B1, while old B1 and protected B1 both listen to the same book payment.
critical_holes.required_fix: Route H1 to protected B1, keep the provider-success trigger for gifts, and retire the duplicate paid entry after a controlled paid checkout test.
critical_holes.why: This removes duplicate or timing-dependent book welcomes.

critical_holes.title: Wire Founding Students
critical_holes.finding: The correct pipeline and stages exist, but the selling events do not create or move its opportunities.
critical_holes.required_fix: Create or move one opportunity on trial start, calculator completion, call booking, call held, close, loss, and day-14 ghost.
critical_holes.why: Alex cannot run sales from a pipeline that stays empty.

critical_holes.title: Run one true paid journey
critical_holes.finding: Pages and automations exist, but a fresh payment has not proved book access, Engine upsell, B1 behavior, pipeline movement, and received messages together.
critical_holes.required_fix: Use one new buyer email and follow it from checkout through GoHighLevel, Thinkific, inbox, booking, and pipeline.
critical_holes.why: Static workflow reads cannot prove the full customer experience.

critical_holes.title: Automate no-show and outcomes
critical_holes.finding: E2 needs a manually added no-show tag, and no Founding Students outcome automations were found.
critical_holes.required_fix: Trigger no-show recovery from the OFFICIAL Blueprint Call status and add simple held, won, lost, and ghost stage writers.
critical_holes.why: The pipeline should follow the real call without Alex rebuilding history by hand.

critical_holes.title: Connect the Partner pipeline
critical_holes.finding: Partner signup and welcome work, but the lifecycle pipeline has zero opportunities.
critical_holes.required_fix: Create a Partner opportunity at signup and move it on login, onboarding call, first commission, continued support, and loss.
critical_holes.why: The current partner machine delivers links but does not give a usable operating board.

critical_holes.title: Remove internal notes from the public toolkit
critical_holes.finding: The public toolkit page source exposes developer comments and internal rate notes.
critical_holes.required_fix: Remove the internal comments from the live custom HTML and recheck the rendered page and page source.
critical_holes.why: Internal instructions should not ship to Partners or appear in public source.

critical_holes.title: Verify the live attribution window
critical_holes.finding: The approved source says 60 days, but the live Affiliate Manager setting was not reverified in this audit.
critical_holes.required_fix: Open the current campaign settings, record the live window, and align the portal and any human-facing copy.
critical_holes.why: The attribution promise must match what GoHighLevel actually credits.

critical_holes.title: Standardize call links and names
critical_holes.finding: Strategy Call names, a direct widget link, the older JMPTR call link, and the approved sharknow.co/blueprint link all remain in use.
critical_holes.required_fix: Use Blueprint Call in human-facing copy and standardize on sharknow.co/blueprint after checking every workflow link.
critical_holes.why: Working links are still a maintenance and reporting risk when several addresses mean the same action.

critical_holes.title: Add exact source fields
critical_holes.finding: Five of seven intended Founding Students card fields exist. The two exact source fields are missing.
critical_holes.required_fix: Add Source (First UTM) and Source (Self-Report), then wire the forms and calculator sync.
critical_holes.why: Lead Source alone cannot preserve both original attribution and what the buyer says.

critical_holes.title: Freeze the sales label contract
critical_holes.finding: Ownership and call-state labels exist, but the sales pipeline has no complete writer map and H1's exact paid-book tag writer needs a fresh configuration read during repair.
critical_holes.required_fix: Record one approved writer and every reader for purchase:book, the Engine ownership labels, B2 active, call booked, and no-show before changing the workflows.
critical_holes.why: A short label contract stops future Codex or Claude sessions from creating a second name for the same event.

strengths: The customer-facing book, Engine, call, confirmation, partner, toolkit, and terms pages exist and returned HTTP 200.
The OFFICIAL Blueprint Call calendar is active and redirects to the correct confirmation page.
H1 already handles book ownership, Thinkific access, and an opportunity record.
B1, B2, E1, and E2 contain substantial follow-up instead of empty shells.
The Founding Students pipeline has the exact eight intended stages.
AF1 and AF2 create a working signup, Affiliate Manager enrollment, Partner ID, welcome, toolkit, and onboarding path.
The current AF2 Welcome V6 uses working personalized links and does not publish the stale commission table.
risks: Two published B1 workflows can react to the same paid book event.
The intended sales pipeline is nearly empty because current workflows write elsewhere or do not write opportunities.
Legacy pipelines and legacy workflow names make it easy to connect future work to the wrong place.
A manual no-show tag means recovery depends on Alex remembering an administrative step.
The Partner journey has customer delivery but no lifecycle board.
The public toolkit contains internal comments in its source.
The email-template endpoint is unavailable, so this audit cannot certify every global email template.
mvp_fix_order: Freeze one canonical B1 entry design and run the true paid book checkout canary.
Add Founding Students opportunity writes for call booked, call held, won, lost, and ghost.
Turn E2 from a manual tag into a calendar no-show trigger.
Create the two missing source fields and connect the current booking form and calculator handoff.
Create the SLM Affiliate Lifecycle opportunity at Partner signup and move it through the real milestones.
Remove the public toolkit developer comments and verify the live attribution window.
Run the full book-to-call-to-sale test and the full Partner signup-to-onboarding test.
later_improvements: Consolidate legacy call calendars, old sales pipelines, and old workflow names after the MVP is proven.
Create Alex's pre-call one-page brief from calculator, contact, attribution, purchase, and appointment data.
Add daily and weekly reports once the first real volume makes individual notifications noisy.
Add revenue and source dashboards after the pipeline events are trustworthy.
Repair the workflow-guts pull tool so future audits can capture structured actions without browser-only reads.

lamar_handoff: Use FOUNDING STUDENTS as the only current customer sales pipeline for the On-Demand Revenue Engine motion.
Do not connect new work to Book a Call, SLM Customers, or the old funding, CCA, and credit sales pipelines without a dated migration decision.
Record the exact event that should move each of the eight stages before building any workflow.
Keep the Partner journey separate in SLM Affiliate Lifecycle, and create its first opportunity at application or approval.
Use Blueprint Call in human-facing names and sharknow.co/blueprint as the managed link after the link audit.
Do not call the Partner experience an affiliate program in human-facing copy. GoHighLevel may still label its back-end feature Affiliate Manager.
Require a dated receipt for every live change: exact asset, old state, new state, Codex test, Alex test, and remaining whole-system test.
